## How it stays safe

Which of these does it touch, and how does it keep the rule?

- Policy before signer, fail closed
- No MCP tool that approves, unlocks, or raises a limit
- No destination from untrusted text
- No key material on stdout, argv, tool results, or logs
- No new outbound host without operator configuration
